data.name: Cotton Electric Service, Inc.
data.address: 1130 S Cedar Ridge Dr, Duncanville, TX 75137

reviews.text:
Recently, I had a new oven installed by Cotton Electric Service which required rewiring at the breaker box along with a few other electrical updates. From start to finish, the team was professional, efficient, and clearly knowledgeable.

I always prefer to support local businesses, and this experience just reaffirmed that choice. I’ll definitely be using Cotton Electric for my future electrical needs!

From the initial phone call with Randy, to the completion of services provided, Cotton Electric Services was amazing to work with. Randy was not only efficient, but he was honest and trustworthy, which goes a long way and is rare to find in a contractor. We highly recommend Cotton Electric Service Inc for your electric needs.

Josh & Michael are very good electricians and good men. They helped me out of a nightmare with a battery. And I will be forever grateful.
They both have a servant’s heart and I will recommend their services and company to everyone who wants electrical services.
This world would be a better place if there were more Josh’s and Michael’s.

“Those of us who are strong and able in the faith need to step in and lend a hand to those who falter, and not just do what is convenient for us.  Strength is fo

Excellent work and customer service!

I cannot say enough positives about our experience with Cotton Electric!

My mother passed away on Easter morning and five days later the meter base in the home she shared with my father burned up.  My 86 year old father had just lost his wife of 63 years, and now was dealing with the loss of electricity to their home.  He was overwhelmed with grief and stress!

When I called Cotton Electric, Ashlee recognized the emergent need and dispatched two electrician

Josh & Damon did an awesome job! They were very polite and professional and the lighting install looks amazing.  They were extremely skilled and knowledgeable and walked me through each step of what they were doing, and asked my input as well.  They were conscientious & respectful &  they cleaned up everything.  I’m more than satisfied and I would highly recommend them to anyone.  A job well done!

Called them to replace a couple of breakers for a split mini ac we installed. They arrived sooner than expected. James and Ross quickly took care of the install and were super cool guys. Definitely my go to from now on!

Cotton Electric recently helped us resolve a power fluctuation issue.  They did an electrical inspection on our older home, corrected several small issues, and replaced a breaker.  The fluctuation was still present so they advised that we get Oncor involved and help get a service order going.  Oncor promptly diagnosed and repaired the issue.  It had the potential to cause big problems so we were grateful for Cotton's advice and Oncor's response.  We've used Cotton Electric several times and alwa

Very responsible electrical company.  We've used them for more than 10 years.  We have never had a problem with any of their work.  They do just about everything right.  They respond quickly, and that's tough these days.  Every technician who has performed work has been knowledgeable and easy to talk to.  I hope they stay in business forever.

This company solved my lighting issues where several other companies said it couldn’t be done. It just took a little more time and they were willing to do it. They were on time, knowledgeable, courteous and informative. They were also very reasonably priced. I would recommend this group 100%. I will be using them exclusively in the future.

The gentlemen were very professional and did a great job with the upgrade and relocation of our 60 year old panel as well as additional outlets and upgraded LED lighting (major difference in our kitchen area). I highly recommend Jody and his company.

The interactions with the company was very easy straight forward and pleasant.
Josh and Damon were on time friendly professional and very knowledgeable they worked diligently and completed the task sooner than expected I have nothing but thumbs up for those guys great job.

I went with Cotton because of the good reviews so why did I give 1 star?
1) The phone call was $70, this price covers nothing but making an appointment, does not contribute to ANY work or assessment.
2) They came out, took 2-3 hours, couldn't find the problem, called in another guy, he took another 1+ hours to find the problem (which theynever found) so decided to run a power line down my wall USING MY CABLE (which is fine until you see total cost).
3)  Pulled something like 7 outlets and "requi

Damian and Trey did an outstanding job. Very pleasant and knowledgeable installing 4 overhead light, 4 under counter lights and fan/light combo in eating area. They left my home well lit, cool and clean. Thank you for your help! You guys rock !!!

I have worked with Randy and his team on several occasions for all different electric matters. They are skilled, responsive, polite and always ready to explain what their findings were etc. I will choose them for ALL my electrical needs, you should too!

Cotten electric installed a generator interlock and necessary breakers and wall receptacle for my home generator. At the same time they installed a whole home surge protector. Cotten electric did a great job, very happy with them. They are now my go to for any electrical work. Highly recommend.

I highly recommend Cotton Electric!!! We called late afternoon needing to get something done quickly after finding some faulty wiring. Randy sent out his guys first thing the next morning. Trey and Damon showed up, knocked out the job quickly, and was super knowledgeable and answered our questions. If you need any electrical work done, these are your guys!
Trey and Damian did a great job of installing our fans, fixing our light switch, and installing the Ring doorbell. They were very nice, and I would recommend them to anyone needing a job done.
Technician was very honest and reliable with us. They did what the previous electric repair company said couldn’t be done. I’m so glad we got a second opinion from Cotton. Would highly recommend.

I have had many services done by Cotton Electric including extensive outdoor lighting. I just had my kitchen redone with recessed lighting with Trey and Damon. They did a wonderful job including cleanup.

Tra and Damon came to fix our electric problems and they did an amazing job. They are very professional and got the problems fixed in a timely matter. We will recommend this company. Thanks again for your services.

I was very happy with the quick and courteous service.  Even asked the guys to do a last minute help with a "stuck" light fixture and light bulb which has plagued me for a while.  Very sweet and clean - will call again!

As a general contractor, it has been my privilege to work with Cotton Electric Service for over twenty years. From simple repair work to complex restorations and high end remodels they have been there to get the job done well. I often recommend them with confidence to clients that need some electrical work. I look forward to working with them in the future and the fantastic quality they produce.

Doug Wuerch
Wuerch Contracting Inc.

Cotten Electric sent two men out to repair the box and GFIC plug on our backyard pond. They came out in the afternoon and did a great job. I will call them again as needed, thanks guys for the repair, kudos to y’all.

I can't speak enough about the outstanding service provided for electrical work for our hot tub. Safety precautions were explained in details. They were on time for hot tub delivery and fun to talk to!
Home A/C Unit was not working;  called in and a couple of techs arrived within an  hour or so. Diagnosed the problem, repaired it and my A/C was back on in no time. Excellent service!!!
The electrician was installing an interlock system on my main panel and an external outlet to plug my power generator. The work was well done, and the electrician was very professional.
I had two ceiling fans replaced with a couple of outlets and these guys did an awesome job. Very honest and get the job done quickly. I’m a customer for life!
Josh is AMAZING! He was very kind and patient and did an amazing job!!! I’d definitely use this service again!
Josh and his team are wonderful. Great service, quick solutions and friendly as ever!
The guys that did the installation were great. They explained everything to me. They even showed me the problem.
Needed a AC breaker replaced. They got me fixed and blowing cold the same day! Very professional and I will use again!
I highly recommend Cotton Electric Service. Very knowledgeable, efficient and friendly. Trey and Damon were AMAZING!
This was my first experience and I highly recommend Cotton Electric for someone looking for an honest and trustworthy electrician.
Excellent and great team. They did great work and made sure everything was done right.
Very professional and fair! I highly recommend and will use them again!
The second time using the very professional Cotton's Electric!  Will continue to be our families go to Electric Service.
Wonderful Service and did Everything 👏 yo get a tech out to My Recidents.... …
They were on time quiet and were finished in good time and very competitively priced.
Great experience!  Professional, prompt, personable, and fairly priced
It's a good work place. Faith ran good service quality  work.
Did a great job in a timely manner. Was there the next day 👍👍 …
Very professional fast effective and efficient
Punctual and friendly.  Would use again.
The only place that provides electric to where I live. 😂 …
Great job, polite and helpful.
Thank you Steve for the 5-star review!  We appreciate you!
Thank you Steve for the 5-star review!  We appreciate you!
Mr. Miller, I appreciate your 5-star review and support.  I am glad we could get your dryer circuit back up and operational!  Thank you again!
We appreciate your business and the 5-star review!!  Thank you!
